pattern: `UnsafeUtility.MemCpy` from native copy buffer into managed callback data
risk: Transfer shim only; release acceptance needs native bridge/DSP profiler proof.

pattern: Manual zero loop over managed callback array
risk: No allocation token in static source; used for underrun/invalid host silence.

pattern: Acquires state/codec/telemetry/counters/waveform/bank views with mutation guard

pattern: `Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()` before decode

pattern: Pins managed Unity `float[]` output

pattern: Raw pointers resolved from DataVault `NativeArray` views

pattern: `Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()` after decode
